steps.name: Parallel Knowledge Base Ingestion & Digest
steps.command: find ~/ecosystem -type f \( -name '*.py' -o -name '*.sh' -o -name '*.json' -o -name '*.md' \) | xargs -P 4 -I {} sh -c 'echo "[Digest] Processing: {}" && head -n 5 "{}"'

steps.name: Execute Local Git Sync Bridge
steps.command: bash ~/ecosystem/git_bridge/sync.sh || echo '[Bridge] Skipping external push (local-only mode)'
